title: chatlinks
description: this mod makes links sent in chat clickable
body:
# chatlinks
## fabric mod that makes links sent in chat clickable
**client side, works on every server!**

**includes all messages in chat**

**note:** no other mods than fabric-api are needed

## screenshots:
